Class Point2DSupport

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.util.Point2DSupport
public final class Point2DSupport extends Object
Static operations on two-dimensional points interpreted as vectors.

    • azimuth

      public static double azimuth(Point2D.Double wp0, Point2D.Double wp1)
      Computes the azimuth from this world point to another. The azimuth is the angle, in degrees, measured clockwise from north (the positive y axis) to the line connecting the two points.

      Unlike a normalized compass bearing, the result is not restricted to [0, 360) — it is derived directly from Math.atan2(double, double) and can be negative (e.g. a westward vector returns -90, not 270). Callers that need a normalized [0, 360) sweep should use AngleSupport.ccwSweepDeg(Point2D.Double, Point2D.Double) or equivalent instead.

      Parameters:
      wp0 - the starting world point.
      wp1 - the ending world point.
      Returns:
      the azimuth from wp0 to wp1, in degrees; not normalized to [0, 360)
